name: joy2know-tianyin-maestro
description: joy2know Tianyin Music Maestro: turns a rough idea into ready-to-paste prompts and operating advice for NetEase Tianyin's AI song composer — the everyday default is Advanced mode, the same two-panel structure as the advanced modes of Suno and Mureka: a style description plus section-tagged lyrics (each ≤1000 chars), with the panel picks (vocal gender, one of 18 virtual-singer timbres, chorus-first — measured to hurt quality, so leave it off — and a song title ≤30 chars); simple mode (one inspiration paragraph ≤1000 chars) is kept for quick one-prompt songs. Also writes lyrics from scratch (hook-first, genre-accurate rhyme schemes, a cliche blacklist) and designs whole albums (one Q&A round to an album plan document plus a per-song paste list, with timbre anchors, a difference matrix and per-song cover prompts). Prompts and operating advice only — no audio is generated, no generative AI API is called, no account or key is carried.

displayDescription.en: Turns ideas into ready-to-paste Tianyin input (Advanced mode by default), writes lyrics that sing, and designs whole albums. Prompts and operating advice only — no songs are generated.
displayDescription.zh: 把想法写成能粘进网易天音的输入：默认高级模式，风格加歌词两栏，配 18 位虚拟歌手。也设计专辑。只产提示词，不生成歌曲。
